independence_classes.partially_independent: a different provider that may share upstream market data with ours (Chainlink and CoinMarketCap against CoinGecko); not fully independent
independence_classes.transport_corroboration: the same chain state read from a second node at the same block: corroborates retrieval, not economic truth
independence_classes.contract_identity_control: validates which contract and implementation is live and whether its source is verified; not a value confirmation
independence_classes.naming_control: validates that a name resolves back to the address; not ownership or treasury attribution
independence_classes.realizability_control: validates how much of a position could be withdrawn now; not price
